newsitem.title: USA: Cybercash CFO to resign in late December.
newsitem.headline: Cybercash CFO to resign in late December.

text.p: CyberCash Inc said Tuesday that Gene Riechers, chief financial officer, will be resigning effective in late December to be the Managing Director of a new venture capital fund, Pegasus Venture Partners LP, an affiliate of Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc.

"This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity," Riechers commented. "And it is the culmination of a career path that I have been on for some years. I am very excited about this personal opportunity to help build a unique venture capital firm here in the greater Washington, D.C. area."

CyberCash said "Gene has been working with us to make this transition as smooth as possible and has assisted in recruiting a top-notch replacement, who will have Gene's full support in the transition." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
